correctness.rationale: Definitions and quantifiers are explicit: fixed eccentricity 0<e<1, unsaturated geometric transit probability, isotropic impact parameter, uniform periastron, and duration-power weight for 0<=alpha<=3. The half-angle/rescaling/inversion substitution proves the exact moment identity without numerical inference. Strict tilted log-variance proves the unique alpha=3/2 global minimum; Jensen gives a strict nonlinear averaging correction. Dominated convergence and elliptic K asymptotic prove distinct high-e branches; the singular limit is formal with shrinking size ratio. The checker validates 92 finite numerical consistency assertions, not infinite validity.

originality.rationale: The manuscript isolates a phase-weighted duration-power yield functional and proves a previously-unidentified exponent reflection, strict global minimum at exponent 3/2, exact mean-power discrepancy and critical log asymptotic. Burke 2008 already provides a complete duration distribution and an average-duration yield proxy; that is acknowledged as broader data-distribution coverage, not claimed as a new model. Classically known Legendre identities and uninspected downstream applications create explicit residual priority risk.
residual_risks: Burke’s full duration distribution mathematically determines all moments and might be viewed as broader implicit coverage of the integrated yield functional; no novelty is asserted for the forward distribution itself.

A Tingley–Sackett (2005) duration discussion and other downstream work are not exhaustively inspected; historical priority therefore remains provisional.

value.rationale: The natural observational motivation is a sharp correction to replacing the phase-weighted mean of a nonlinear duration-dependent survey response by a power of the phase-averaged duration. A full response-exponent duality, unique physical white-noise minimum, and the critical log high-e asymptotic classify the idealized family and show a concrete 5.46% discrepancy at e=1/2. The model is narrowly stated and does not overclaim empirical detectability; its novelty cannot rest on computation alone.
